How we work

A straight line from chaos to autopilot.

Five phases. No mystery, no scope-creep theatre — you see every step, and every step ships something.

01

Phase 01 — DiscoverDeep-dive diagnostics

We embed with your team for a week, map every workflow, and find where the hours and money actually leak. No slideware — a forensic audit of how your business really runs.

Output — Opportunity map & automation scorecard
02

Phase 02 — DesignBlueprint the experience

Brand, interface, and system architecture designed together, so the thing customers see and the machine underneath it are the same thought.

Output — Prototypes, design system, system spec
03

Phase 03 — BuildShip the foundation

Weekly releases you can click, not status decks. Production-grade code, tested and instrumented from the first commit.

Output — Live product, staging & analytics wired
04

Phase 04 — AutomateTurn on the machine

Agents, integrations, and pipelines go live against real work: support triage, lead routing, invoicing, reporting. Humans stay on judgment; software takes the repetition.

Output — Automations in production, hours reclaimed
05

Phase 05 — Launch + SupportCompound the gains

Launch is the starting line. We monitor, tune, and extend the system monthly — every quarter it does more, and costs you less attention.

Output — SLA support, quarterly optimization

CORE_ENGINE_V4.0 // SCENARIO_01 — CUSTOMER_SUPPORT
Scenario 01 / Before

Every ticket touched by hand, every customer kept waiting.

  • ✕Four hours a day lost triaging a shared inbox nobody owns.
  • ✕First response in 6–12 hours; urgent issues buried under noise.
  • ✕Answers vary by agent and mood — CSAT slides quarter after quarter.
Scenario 01 / After

Answers in seconds. Humans only on the moments that matter.

  • AI triage reads, classifies, and routes every ticket on arrival.
  • 90% of tickets resolved automatically with grounded, on-brand answers.
  • 24/7, multilingual — edge cases escalate with full context attached.
Outcome

First response cut from hours to under 60 seconds — CSAT up 22 points in one quarter.

CORE_ENGINE_V4.0 // SCENARIO_02 — INVOICING_&_COLLECTIONS
Scenario 02 / Before

Cash flow held hostage by paperwork.

  • ✕Invoices assembled by hand from timesheets and spreadsheets.
  • ✕Chasing late payers over email — awkward, inconsistent, forgotten.
  • ✕Month-end reconciliation becomes a three-day marathon.
Scenario 02 / After

Invoices that send, chase, and reconcile themselves.

  • Auto-generated invoices the moment work is marked delivered.
  • Smart reminder sequences that escalate politely — and actually get paid.
  • Real-time reconciliation against the ledger; anomalies flagged instantly.
Outcome

Days-sales-outstanding down 38%, with zero invoices missed in twelve months.

CORE_ENGINE_V4.0 // SCENARIO_03 — LEAD_ROUTING
Scenario 03 / Before

Hot leads going cold in a spreadsheet.

  • ✕Every enquiry lands in one inbox and waits for a human to notice.
  • ✕Qualification is guesswork; reps burn hours on dead-end accounts.
  • ✕Follow-up in days, not minutes — competitors get there first.
Scenario 03 / After

Every lead scored, routed, and greeted — in under a minute.

  • Instant enrichment & scoring from firmographic and intent signals.
  • Routed to the right rep with a briefing note, not a bare email address.
  • CRM updated automatically — every touch logged without a keystroke.
Outcome

Speed-to-lead under 60 seconds and a +31% close rate on inbound.

CORE_ENGINE_V4.0 // SCENARIO_04 — REPORTING
Scenario 04 / Before

Every Monday morning lost to slide decks.

  • ✕Numbers pulled by hand from six different tools, every single week.
  • ✕Screenshots pasted into decks that are stale before the meeting starts.
  • ✕Nobody trusts the figures — two versions of the truth in every room.
Scenario 04 / After

The report writes itself before anyone logs in.

  • Live dashboards unify every source — one truth, always current.
  • Plain-language summaries land in Slack and inboxes at 7 a.m. Monday.
  • Anomaly alerts the moment a metric moves — not at month-end.
Outcome

Weekly reporting effort: 6 hours → 0. Decisions made on live data.

CORE_ENGINE_V4.0 // SCENARIO_05 — CLIENT_ONBOARDING
Scenario 05 / Before

New clients stuck in two weeks of email ping-pong.

  • ✕Contracts, forms, and credentials scattered across threads.
  • ✕Kickoffs slip because someone forgot to send something.
  • ✕Clients re-answer the same questions for three different teams.
Scenario 05 / After

Signed on Monday, kicked off by Wednesday.

  • Self-serve portal provisioned automatically at contract signature.
  • Documents generated & e-signed — data flows straight into every system.
  • Kickoff scheduled automatically with agenda and context pre-briefed.
Outcome

Onboarding cut from 14 days to 48 hours — and clients feel it on day one.
